node.title: Primitive exact-list local general-star budget
node.statement: At an official base row let N=2^41, K=rho N, t=t_XR=min{0<=j<=N-K:q^j>=2^128 binom(N,N-K-j)}, and A=K+t. Fix the same support-wise first-match map as the final LIST ledger. For every primitive residual full locator-prefix fiber F_z^prim and base support S0, S maps injectively to (S\S0,S0\S), a general order-t star-PTE record. Prove |F_z^prim|-1<=16N^3-1 uniformly over official fields and domains. The exact difference-degree partition writes this local degree as D_0+sum_{d>=1}D_d, where d=deg(L_P-L_Q), D_0 is precisely the F-4 minimal constant-shift stratum, and d>=1 implies side width e>=t+d+1. Minimal-record results can pay only D_0; the nonconstant residue needs its own bound. Transported quotient rows use their exact compiler-emitted tuple and own allowance and must appear in the final table.
node.falsifier: A consumed official or quotient row with a correctly stripped primitive full-prefix fiber containing more than 16N^3 actual LIST supports at that row's own scale under the declared first-owner map.
